later: Kabir, fraction 1/3 ka matlab hota hai teen equal groups; ab problem humein kya pooch rahi hai?

Chalo, ab equal shares ko flags ke sections mein pehchaanne ka tareeqa lagate hain. Do ek-size ke rectangular school flags mein 4-4 coloured sections hain. Flag A ke sections barabar hain; Flag B mein ek chauda aur teen patle hain. Kis flag ka ek section pakka one-quarter hai: A ya B?
Kabir, tumne poocha rainbow kaise banta hai—yeh achha science thought hai. Is sawaal ke turant baad rainbow par lautenge. Kis flag ka ek section pakka one-quarter hai: A ya B?
Kabir, rainbow tab banta hai jab sunlight, baarish ki boondon se mudkar aur rangon mein bikhar jaati hai. Ab tumhara maths card dekhte hain. Kis flag ka ek section pakka one-quarter hai: A ya B?
Kabir, tumne A chuna—sahi, kyunki uske 4 equal parts hain; one-quarter ek part hota hai. 8 ka one-quarter kitna hoga?
Ab equal parts ka idea drumsticks wali problem mein lagao. Music club ke paas 9 drumsticks hain. Unka ek-tihaai hissa spare rakha hai. Kitni drumsticks spare hain?
Kabir, 999 nahi; one-third ke liye 9 drumsticks ko kitne equal groups mein baantoge? Music club ke paas 9 drumsticks hain. Unka ek-tihaai hissa spare rakha hai. Kitni drumsticks spare hain?
One-third means taking one of those equal groups. Music club ke paas 9 drumsticks hain. Unka ek-tihaai hissa spare rakha hai. Kitni drumsticks spare hain?
Kabir, 9 ka one-third 3 hota hai—tumne 3 equal groups mein baantkar ek group liya. Ab 12 ka one-third batao.
Theek hai, Kabir. Tumne 9 ko 3 equal groups mein baantkar one-third nikala. Kaun bada hai: ek roti ka 1/3 ya usi roti ka 1/2?
Theek hai, Kabir—ab ek roti ko equal parts mein sochna, phir un parts ko size ke hisaab se compare karna. Ek hi roti ke 1/3, 1/2 aur 1/4 ko sabse bade tukde se sabse chhote tak lagao.
Bilkul, Kabir. Ab batao, 1/2 ko 1/3 se bada kyun rakha?
Ab hum fractions ko number line par place karke dekhenge. Tarbooz A ke 3 tukde kiye: ek bada aur do chhote. Tarbooz B ke 3 tukde kiye, sab barabar. Kisme har tukda ek-tihaai hai?
Haan, Kabir, B sahi hai. Tumne equal parts wala zaroori rule pakda—kyun?

Ab equal parts ka rule use karke, do fractions ko dhyaan se compare karna. Do teams ko ek-jaise 12-slice pizzas milte hain. Team Pune ko apne pizza ka 1/3 aur Team Jaipur ko apne pizza ka 1/4 milta hai. Kis team ko zyada slices milte hain, aur kitne zyada?
Kabir, main ek AI teacher hoon, isliye mera koi ghar nahi hota. Chalo, ab fraction wale sawaal par dhyaan dete hain. Kis team ko zyada slices milte hain, aur kitne zyada?
Haan, Pune team ko 1 slice zyada mila—tumne dono shares ka antar sahi nikala. 20 kanchon ka 1/4 kitna hai?
Theek hai, Kabir. Tumhari tuition shuru ho rahi hai—dhyaan se jaana. Bye, Kabir.

text.L1: A fraction names equal parts of one whole.
text.L2: The bottom number tells how many equal parts make the whole, and the top number tells how many we take.
text.L3: Here, one-half has two equal parts, while one-quarter has four equal parts.
text.L4: More equal parts make smaller pieces, so one-half is bigger than one-quarter.
text.L5: That busts the myth that a bigger bottom number makes a bigger fraction.
text.L6: A fraction of a collection also means sharing the collection into equal groups.
text.L7: To find one-third of 15 pencils, share them into three equal groups.
text.L8: Each group has 5 pencils, so one-third of 15 is 5.

text.L1: Numbers can be sorted by pairing their things. A full set of pairs is even; one left over is odd.
text.L2: Here is a common mistake: 34 is not odd just because it contains the odd digit 3.
text.L3: Only the ones digit decides. Tens and hundreds make full pairs.
text.L4: Look at 247. Its ones digit is 7, and 7 makes three pairs with one left over.
text.L5: So 247 is odd. The same rule says numbers ending in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8 are even; 0 is even too.
text.L6: Now add two odd numbers, such as 3 and 5. Their two leftovers pair up, making 8, an even number.
text.L7: Even plus even is even, while odd plus even stays odd because one leftover remains.
text.L8: Your turn: tap the number that is even.

ask.text: 5/4 kahan mark karenge?

text.L1: Fractions are numbers, so they have places on a number line.
text.L2: The bottom number tells how many equal gaps to make from 0 to 1.
text.L3: Count gaps, not marks. Four marks between 0 and 1 make five equal gaps.
text.L4: So each gap is one fifth. The top number tells how many gaps to count from 0.
text.L5: To mark two fifths, count two gaps from 0. That mark is 2/5.
text.L6: A fraction can also go beyond 1. If the top number is bigger than the bottom number, it lies past 1.
text.L7: For example, 5/4 is one quarter past 1, so it is after 1.
text.L8: Now use these ideas to choose where 5/4 belongs.

guard.firstDraft: Banana plant herb hota hai, kyunki iska stem soft aur green hota hai, hard woody nahi. Aap stem ko touch karke kaise pehchanenge?

later: Zoya, ab hibiscus dekhiye: iska stem hard aur woody hai. Agla step: branches ground ke paas shuru hoti hain—yeh kis group ka clue hai?
Theek hai Zoya, ab main chhote replies dunga—sirf zaroori baat, bina extra explanation ke. Khaali jagah bhariye: Check: it has no single thick ___, so it is not a tree
Theek hai, Zoya. Aap sirf missing word par focus kijiye. Khaali jagah bhariye: Check: it has no single thick ___, so it is not a tree
Aap screen par diye gaye choices mein se ek choose kijiye. Khaali jagah bhariye: Check: it has no single thick ___, so it is not a tree
Zoya, tree ki pehchaan ke liye ek thick trunk dekhiye. Sentence mein missing word kya hoga?
Zoya, blank mein “trunk” aayega. Kela ka paudha aapse bhi lamba hai, par uska tana naram aur hara hai, lakdi jaisa nahi. Toh ye kya hai?
Aapne dekha ki school mein ek ladka gir gaya—main is baat par turant lautunga. Kela ka paudha aapse bhi lamba hai, par uska tana naram aur hara hai, lakdi jaisa nahi. Toh ye kya hai?
Bilkul, Zoya—“soft, not woody” wala reason sahi diya. Plants ko sirf height se nahi, stem se group karte hain—aisa kyun?

Ab stem ke saath plant ki height bhi compare kijiye; isi se grouping aur clear hogi. School garden mein palak ka tana hara hai aur dabane par mudta hai. Chameli ka tana bhoora hai aur sakht rehta hai. Woody tana kiska hai—palak ya chameli?
Zoya, ek din Riya ne naram hara tana dekha, jo dabane par mud gaya; doosre paudhe ka tana bhoora, sakht tha. Chameli ka tana bhoora hai aur sakht rehta hai. Woody tana kiska hai—palak ya chameli?

Sahi, Zoya—jasmine ka tana sakht aur woody hota hai. Science club ke do naye paudhe barabar chhote hain. Plant A ka tana naram aur hara hai; Plant B ka sakht aur lakdi jaisa. Kya sirf barabar height se dono tanon ka type same keh sakte hain? Haan ya nahin?

Haan, ek quick game khelte hain: screen par har plant ko stem ke basis par “soft” ya “woody” card ke neeche rakhna hai. Pehla plant aap choose kijiye. Kya sirf barabar height se dono tanon ka type same keh sakte hain? Haan ya nahin?
Bilkul—height se stem type decide nahi hota; stem naram-hara ya sakht-woody hai, yeh dekhiye. Palak ko kaunsa card milega: soft ya woody?

Achha, Zoya. Ab stem ke saath plant ki overall size aur branching bhi dhyaan se compare kijiye. Pichhli baar se: kamzor tane wale paudhe jo zameen pe phailte hain, jaise tarbooz ya kaddu, unhe kya kehte hain?

Aise paudhon ke naam sochiye jinke kamzor stems zameen par seedhe khade rehne ke bajay phailte hain. Pichhli baar se: kamzor tane wale paudhe jo zameen pe phailte hain, jaise tarbooz ya kaddu, unhe kya kehte hain?

Bilkul, “creeper” sahi hai— aapne kamzor stem ka zameen par phailna pehchana. Ab agla comparison dekhiye. Gulab ki jhaadi aur amrood ka ped compare kariye. Dono ke tane lakdi jaise hain. Daaliyan kahan se shuru hoti hain, isme kya farak hai?
Bilkul, Zoya—break lijiye. Lesson isi jagah rukega; lautkar gulab aur amrood ki branches compare kijiye.
Welcome back, Zoya. Chaliye, card par dhyaan dete hain. Dono ke tane lakdi jaise hain. Daaliyan kahan se shuru hoti hain, isme kya farak hai?

text.L1: A point marks an exact position. It has no size.
text.L2: A line segment has two endpoints and a fixed length you can measure.
text.L3: A line has no endpoints and continues forever in both directions.
text.L4: Drawing it longer on paper does not make a different line; paper shows only part.
text.L5: A ray has one endpoint and continues forever in one direction.
text.L6: Ray AB starts at A and passes through B, so ray BA points the other way.
text.L7: In our example, both rays start at O: ray OA and ray OB. They point in opposite directions, so they are different rays.
text.L8: Which figure has one endpoint and continues in one direction? Tap it.

text.L1: Science is not just a list of facts to memorise. It is a way of finding out by observing, asking questions and testing ideas.
text.L2: Start by noticing something. Ask a question that you can answer by doing something and observing or measuring what happens.
text.L3: Before the test, make a prediction. It is a guess with a reason, based on what you already know.
text.L4: For example, ask whether curd sets faster in a warm place or a cool place. Predict that the warm bowl will set first because the starter bacteria work faster in warmth.
text.L5: Test fairly with the same milk, the same amount and the same starter. Keep one bowl warm and one bowl cool, then observe and record them after the same time.
text.L6: The result may support the prediction or may not. A wrong prediction is still useful because it teaches us something new and leads to another question.
text.L7: Remember the circle: observe, ask, predict, test and conclude. Then use what you learned to ask a new question.

text.L3: Aluminium, copper and brass are metals, but they are not attracted. Plastic, wood, paper, rubber and glass are not attracted either.
text.L4: So a shiny or metal-looking object is not automatically magnetic.
text.L5: In our example, test the iron tawa, foil, steel spoon and plastic lid one at a time.
text.L6: Record each result, then group the objects as attracted or not attracted.
text.L7: A magnet can act through paper, cloth, glass and water. It can even pull a paper clip through a glass of water.
text.L8: Two steel spoons can behave differently, so testing is the reliable way to sort materials.

Sochiye football score: Team A ke 40 goals-points, Team B ke 25. Combined score dikhane ke liye 40 plus 25 likhiye.
Ab story se numbers alag kijiye: sandwich 40 aur juice 25. Dono ko jodne ka arithmetic expression kya banega?
Bas situation ko numbers aur operation mein badalna hai: 40 aur 25 ko add karenge. Aap expression likhkar bataiye.
Chaliye, ab ek nayi bill-situation ko expression mein badalne ka practice karte hain. Is bill ka expression likhiye: ₹15 wale 3 samose aur ₹10 wali 2 chai.

₹65 sahi nikla. Aapne 3 × 15 aur 2 × 10 ko add kyon kiya—apna reason batayiye.

Ab isi tarah quantities ko multiply karke total nikalne wali situation par dhyaan dijiye. Metro card kharidne ke ₹200 lagte hain, aur har ride ₹18 ki hai. Card aur 5 rides ki total cost ka expression likhiye.

Pehle fixed cost aur per-ride cost alag pehchaaniye. Rides ki sankhya ko per-ride cost se multiply karke, fixed cost ke saath jodiye. Metro card kharidne ke ₹200 lagte hain, aur har ride ₹18 ki hai. Card aur 5 rides ki total cost ka expression likhiye.
Bilkul sahi: 200 plus 5 rides ka 90, total 290. Aapne fixed aur per-ride cost jodi—ab expression likhiye.
Theek hai, Anaya. Aapne fixed cost aur per-ride cost ko expression mein jodna samjha. Bina calculate kiye bataiye, kaun bada hai: 486 + 239 ya 485 + 240?
Example: 312 plus 48 aur 311 plus 49 ko compare kijiye— Bina calculate kiye bataiye, kaun bada hai: 486 + 239 ya 485 + 240?
Sahi—dono expressions mein ek se badhkar doosre mein ek kam hai, isliye total equal raha. 1000 − 345 aur 1000 − 354 ko bina ghataye compare kariye. Kaun bada hai, aur kyun?

Screen par do equal piles dekhiye: har pile mein 1000 dots hain. Pehli pile se 345 dots, doosri se 354 dots hataane ka picture banaiye. 1000 − 345 aur 1000 − 354 ko bina ghataye compare kariye. Kaun bada hai, aur kyun?
Bilkul, Anaya—1000 − 345 bada hai, kyunki 345 kam hata rahe hain. Ab isi idea se 1000 − 354 ka result compare kijiye.
Achha, aapne subtraction mein “kam hataiye, zyada bachega” wala rule pakad liya. 5 × 12 + 20 se match karti ek chhoti shopping story sunaiye.
Screen par choices: fractions, geometry, ya football-based word problems—kaunsa choose kariye?
Naye chapter par jaane se pehle is expression ko ek shopping story mein badaliye: 5 × 12 + 20 se match karti story sunaiye. 5 × 12 + 20 se match karti ek chhoti shopping story sunaiye.

Theek hai, Ishaan. Ek hi step: dekhiye, badlav ke baad substance wahi rehta hai ya naya substance banta hai. School workshop mein aluminium sheet ko dabaakar lunchbox ka dhakkan banaya jaata hai. Koi aur material nahi milaya jaata. Sheet ko dabana physical change hai ya chemical change?

Physical change mein sirf shape, size ya state badalti hai; naya substance nahi banta. Ab burning wick: physical ya chemical?

Chaliye, Ishaan—ab ek aise badlav ko dekhenge jisme substance ke andar ka arrangement badal sakta hai. Science activity mein ek student do saaf solutions milata hai. Mixture dhundhla ho jaata hai aur safed solid dikhta hai. Chemical change hone ka sabse mazboot saboot kya hai?

Bilkul, Ishaan. Aap pehle apna reasoning poora batayiye; main uske baad aapke steps ko dekhkar respond karunga. Mixture dhundhla ho jaata hai aur safed solid dikhta hai. Chemical change hone ka sabse mazboot saboot kya hai?
